What types of commercial properties do you maintain?+

We organise maintenance for hotels and resorts, apartments and common areas, hospitality venues, retail premises, offices, warehouses, industrial properties and community facilities. We confirm the specific work and access requirements for each site.

Can we combine several maintenance jobs in one enquiry?+

Yes. We review your defect list, group related work and identify the materials and access needed. We then set out which tasks can be completed together and which need separate attendance or investigation.

Can repairs be planned around our opening hours?+

We discuss your opening hours, busy periods and access restrictions before booking. We agree the work sequence and confirm available attendance times, including any period when an area or service needs to be unavailable.

Do you coordinate with property and body corporate managers?+

We work with your nominated representative to confirm the approved scope, site access and communication arrangements. We record the work completed and identify any additional items that need a separate decision.

What do you need to prepare a quote?+

We use the property address, type of premises, a description of the issue and any available photos or defect list. We also ask about access, operating hours and the person approving the work. We confirm where a site inspection or investigation is needed.

How do you handle changes to the work scope?+

We record the additional issue, explain the proposed work and confirm any effect on price, materials or timing before proceeding with that change. The completion record distinguishes the original scope from approved additions.

Can you provide photos and a completion summary?+

We include agreed photos and a summary of completed work in the handover. We identify treated areas, relevant service records and any items requiring further approval or attendance.

How does salt air affect the maintenance scope?+

We check exposed and sheltered surfaces, the installed materials, fixings and visible deterioration. We use the relevant product guidance to define cleaning and repairs, and distinguish surface maintenance from component replacement.

Can you plan roof and drainage maintenance before storm season?+

We review previous leaks, roof and gutter condition and accessible drainage points, then agree a scope and attendance window. We include any access constraints and weather-dependent work stages in the plan.

Which Gold Coast areas can we enquire about?+

We take enquiries for Gold Coast commercial properties, including coastal, central and northern business areas. We confirm attendance for your address, the work required and site access when preparing the scope.
